utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Ira — are you still able to help with the repair drive, or should I line someone else up?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can still help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you tell me what time you’re available?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. What do you need most?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — maybe a wrench and a screwdriver would help most. I’ve been a little scattered, so thanks for offering.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can bring those by later today. If you need anything else for the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice turnout — folks are really pitching in. I’ll let you know if I hear anything else useful.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s good to hear. I just hope we’ve got enough trucks and someone keeping track of where everything goes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, that’s the big thing — enough trucks and a steady hand at check-in. I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — I need help collecting the repair supplies from the shed by the community garden and dropping them off at the church basement.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I can grab the supplies from the shed and drop them at the church basement. Just tell me when you want me to head over.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m in—count me in for the repair drive. I’ll spread the word to a few neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Quinn. That means a lot—just let me know if anyone has questions.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll start asking around today and send anyone with questions your way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll start lining up the volunteers and keep the repair drive organized. Let’s make sure everyone knows where to go and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll help spread the word and bring the tool list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Leo — that’ll help a lot. I’ll send out the schedule and we can compare notes before the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which items are on the repair drive list, just so I get the details right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’m a little late to the details myself, but I can help check the list with you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane. Let’s check the list together so I don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’m juggling school pickup right now, but I can help coordinate the repair drive after that.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — that helps a lot. Just ping me after pickup and we’ll get the repair drive sorted.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do — I’ll message you right after pickup and we can lock in the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is happening soon, but I’m still piecing together the details from everyone else. If you know the time or where to drop things off, I’d really appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ve heard it’s this Saturday at the community center, but I’m still checking on the exact drop-off time. If I get the final details, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps a lot. I’ll wait for your update on the drop-off time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the main thing you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirm you’re still handling the repair drive list, and I’ll check off what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m still handling the repair drive list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad the repair drive is happening—what kind of help do you need most?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, mostly hands to sort tools and carry donations, I think. I always mix up the boxes, so any help with keeping things in order would be a big relief.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help sort the tools and keep the boxes straight.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to swing by the repair drive later and see what they need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great idea — I can check our supply list and see what we can spare.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll head over later and let you know what they’re short on.
